node.text:
One last ode to summer eating 🍅

From Paris to Oregon and the Wisconsin State Fair, we had a pretty good run. Swipe for our staff favorites (and maybe a little inspo for your last few weeks of summer eating).

Now tell us yours!

Let the slow cooker do the labor this Labor Day. This bbq pulled pork is smoky, tangy, sweet, and almost entirely hands-off. Comment "🌞" for this recipe (plus 31 more). 🔥🍖🌽🥧

Photo @isa.zapata, styling @tanekamorris, props @campbellpearson

Order the hot chicken at @boltonsfamous, and you’ve been warned: There are no take-backs. 🌶️

At Bolton’s Spicy Chicken & Fish in East Nashville, Dollye Graham-Matthews is carrying on a family recipe passed down from her husband’s uncle, Bolton Polk. The chicken is cooked bone-in in cast iron and coated in a cayenne-heavy dry rub that brings some serious heat—even at “mild.”

Tap the link in bio for our guide to the best hot chicken in Nashville.

🎥 @daphneyyy_ @elliottjeromebrownjr, 🎞️ @jeremykohm
